title: Slow English Stories - Level A2 Listening - A Weird Phone Call!!

header.titleZh: 慢速英語故事 - A2 級聽力 - 一個奇怪的電話！
header.titleEn: Slow English Stories - Level A2 Listening - A Weird Phone Call!!

sentences.en: Hello welcome to my SLO English podcast today.
sentences.tc: 大家好，歡迎來到我今天的 SLO 英文播客。

sentences.en: We will be practicing A2 listening try not to read the captions.
sentences.tc: 我們將練習A2聽力，盡量不要看字幕。

sentences.en: Today I got a weird phone call a strange phone call I.
sentences.tc: 今天接到一個奇怪的電話，一個奇怪的電話。

sentences.en: I was at home drinking a cup of tea and reading a book suddenly my phone rang.
sentences.tc: 我正在家裡喝茶看書，突然手機響了。

sentences.en: Hello a woman with a serious voice answered and said I know what you did I was confused I answered what did.
sentences.tc: 你好，一位女士用嚴肅的聲音回答說我知道你做了什麼我很困惑我回答了什麼。

sentences.en: She said don't pretend you stole my dog stole her dog that was crazy.
sentences.tc: 她說不要假裝你偷了我的狗偷了她的狗，這太瘋狂了。

sentences.en: I love dogs but I would never steal a dog I said I think you have the wrong number I don't have your dog.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡狗，但我永遠不會偷狗，我說我認為你的號碼有誤，我沒有你的狗。

sentences.en: She didn't believe me I saw you you took my dog from the park I said I didn't even go to the park.
sentences.tc: 她不相信我，我看到你了，你把我的狗從公園裡帶走了，我說我甚至沒有去公園。

sentences.en: Today I asked what does your dog look like.
sentences.tc: 今天我問你的狗長什麼樣子。

sentences.en: He is small white and fluffy I said I'm sorry but my dog is not small or white.
sentences.tc: 他又小又白，毛茸茸的，我說對不起，但我的狗不小也不白。

sentences.en: She said oh oh no I think I called the wrong person I'm so sorry.
sentences.tc: 她說哦哦不我想我打錯人了我很抱歉。

sentences.en: I laughed and said I hope you find your dog I hung up.
sentences.tc: 我笑了，說希望你能找到你的狗，我就把電話掛了。

sentences.en: I sat on my couch I shook my head what a weird phone call.
sentences.tc: 我坐在沙發上搖搖頭，真是個奇怪的電話。

sentences.tc: 如果您接到這樣的奇怪電話，請在告訴我之前您是否曾經接到過有趣或奇怪的電話。
